text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the meal.
Phew, we managed to use up quite a lot.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Flash-san, what were you eating~?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: "It's Wurst. My parents sent me the recipe and a mincer, so I tried making it from scratch."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Wurst! That's German sausage, right?
You can make it yourself?! Tha~at's amazing!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Still, it's rare for you to have a late-night snack, Flash-san.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I made so much following the recipe measurements that I've been eating it outside of regular meals too.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I see, so that's how it is~.
You always follow the recipe to the letter☆, don't you!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...Huh?
Hey, Flash, could you possibly be...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Did they soften up a bit?!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes, eating it every day
has caused my weight to gradually increase.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Why are you acting so calm?!
I gained weight! This is an emergency!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
No problem.
The weight gain is within expectations.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: According to my calculations, if I properly adjust my meal portions, I will return to my original weight in no time.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Fueee~h, what's up with that~!?
Even your weight is right on schedule~~!?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Since my parents went out of their way to send this to me,
I wanted to make proper use of it."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I've organized a strict schedule so we can prepare it deliciously
and savor it to the fullest.
Afterward, just as planned, Eishin Flash quickly returned to her original weight.
